principles: legacy history remains lifecycleVersion 1 and never receives fabricated attempt, token, recipient or provider evidence
new jobs use lifecycleVersion 2 and exact policy, recipient, attempt and evidence bindings
legacy montera_admin recipient is never inferred from payload.user_id or current ADMIN_IDS
legacy sending is ambiguous and cannot be retried or cut over until operator reconciliation
after any v2 provider invocation rollback is repair-forward only

orderedPhases.name: PRECHECK_RESTORE
requirements: authenticated owner and reviewer evidence with digest and expiry

orderedPhases.name: PRODUCER_FENCE_AND_PENDING_DRAIN
requirements: stop and revoke legacy producers first
keep bounded legacy dispatcher only for existing pending jobs
no new jobs across two poll intervals

orderedPhases.name: DISPATCHER_FENCE_AND_RECONCILE
requirements: stop dispatcher and revoke claim/retry/id-only sent
ACCESS EXCLUSIVE barrier after old transactions
ambiguous cases have immutable operator evidence

orderedPhases.name: BACKFILL
requirements: policy approval and activation use authenticated governance primitives

orderedPhases.name: VALIDATE
requirements: exact ACL and default ACL matrix

orderedPhases.name: CONTRACT
requirements: zero legacy active rows and sessions
old APIs removed in separate window

rollback.beforeFirstV2Submit: stop new units, disable hardened flag and v1 insert fence, restore legacy code/EXECUTE while retaining additive schema
rollback.afterFirstV2Submit: freeze producers and dispatchers, preserve evidence, reconcile SENT or MANUAL, repair forward; downgrade forbidden

nextCriterion: 064A catalog/ACL hash plus custom backup and clean PostgreSQL 17 restore equality; 064D later owns persisted ambiguous-row disposition
